items.raw_excerpt: The Headstone Project SA questions why less money than promised appears to be available in federal government grants for veterans' graves.
items.summary_en: The Headstone Project SA helps give headstones to veterans who were buried without one. The group fears federal grants will offer less money than promised. Volunteers worry many veterans' graves may still go unmarked.
items.summary_ko: 사우스오스트레일리아의 헤드스톤 프로젝트는 묘비 없이 묻힌 참전용사에게 묘비를 세워 주는 단체입니다. 이 단체는 연방 정부의 지원금이 약속보다 적게 배정될까 걱정하고 있습니다. 자원봉사자들은 많은 참전용사의 무덤이 여전히 표시 없이 남을 수 있다고 우려합니다.
items.title_en: Veterans headstone project fears funding promise falls short of need
items.title_ko: 참전용사 묘비 사업, 약속보다 적은 지원금 우려
items.title_original: Veterans headstone project fears funding promise falls short of need

items.raw_excerpt: Two vocational colleges in central Bangkok have been ordered closed for three months as repeated brawls between their students have affected public safety and the economy, according to the higher education minister.
items.summary_en: Two vocational colleges in central Bangkok have been ordered closed for three months. Their students kept brawling, which hurt public safety and the economy. The higher education minister made the decision.
items.summary_ko: 방콕 시내에 있는 전문대 두 곳이 3개월 동안 문을 닫으라는 명령을 받았습니다. 학생들끼리 계속 싸워서 공공 안전과 경제가 영향을 받았기 때문입니다. 이번 결정은 고등교육 장관이 내렸습니다.
items.title_en: Two Bangkok schools closed for 3 months over student brawls
items.title_ko: 방콕 전문대 두 곳, 학생 싸움 때문에 3개월 문 닫아
items.title_original: Two Bangkok schools closed for 3 months over student brawls

items.raw_excerpt: Technically Latin, but used commonly by French speakers in a technical sense.
items.summary_en: Vade-mecum sounds like Latin, but French speakers use it as a technical word. It means a small handbook or guide that you carry with you. The article explains this word and how it is used in French.
items.summary_ko: 바드메쿰은 라틴어처럼 들리지만, 프랑스어 화자들이 기술적인 뜻으로 쓰는 단어입니다. 손에 들고 다니는 작은 안내서나 길잡이를 뜻합니다. 이 기사는 이 단어와 프랑스어에서의 쓰임새를 설명합니다.
items.title_en: French Word of the Day: Vade-mecum

items.raw_excerpt: There is a Portugal you see from a car window. And then there is the Portugal you meet on foot. A fisherman pulling his boat in after a morning on the Atlantic, looking up to wave as you pass.
items.summary_en: Walking through Portugal shows a side of the country you miss from a car. You pass a fisherman pulling his boat in after a morning on the Atlantic, and he looks up to wave at you. This is how you meet Portugal up close.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈을 걸어서 다니면 차로 볼 때와는 다른 모습이 보입니다. 대서양에서 아침 조업을 마치고 배를 끌어올리는 어부가 지나가는 당신에게 고개를 들어 인사합니다. 이렇게 작고 따뜻한 만남이 걷는 여행의 매력입니다.
items.title_en: Portugal is best discovered on foot
items.title_original: Portugal is best discovered on foot

items.raw_excerpt: Elijah Hollands is at peace with the end of his Carlton career, saying he realises there are more important things in life that he needs to focus on.
items.summary_en: Elijah Hollands was cut from Carlton's AFL team. He says he is at peace with the move and accepts it. He wants to focus on more important things in life.
items.summary_ko: 엘리야 홀랜즈가 칼튼의 AFL 팀에서 방출됐다. 그는 이 결정을 받아들이고 마음이 편하다고 말했다. 이제 인생에서 더 중요한 것에 집중해야 한다고 전했다.
items.title_en: Dropped AFL player wants to focus on life, not football
items.title_ko: 엘리야 홀랜즈, 칼튼에서 방출 뒤 인생의 더 중요한 것에 집중하겠다
items.title_original: Hollands opens up on axing from Carlton AFL roster

items.raw_excerpt: De vez en cuando salen a la luz testimonios de gente que abandona el estrés de la ciudad para empezar de nuevo en un entorno natural. Pero si la vida en los...
items.summary_en: A 28-year-old farmer in Utiel, Valencia, says city people who tell her they love the village only love it when they take holidays there. She says real village life is much harder than it looks from the outside.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 발렌시아 우티엘에서 농사를 짓는 28살 농부가 도시 사람들은 마을이 좋다고 말하지만 휴가를 즐길 때만 좋아하는 것이라고 말합니다. 그녀는 진짜 마을 생활은 겉으로 보이는 것보다 훨씬 힘들다고 이야기합니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Berlin had millions available for cycling projects last year but only spent a fraction of its budget. With less than six percent of a planned bike network completed since 2017, here’s how local politics have put the brakes on a more bikeable capital.
items.summary_en: Berlin had millions of euros for cycling projects last year but spent only a fraction of its budget. Less than six percent of the planned bike network has been built since 2017. Local politics are slowing down the work.
items.summary_ko: 베를린은 지난해 자전거 사업에 수백만 유로를 쓸 수 있었지만 예산의 일부만 사용했다. 2017년 이후 계획된 자전거 도로망의 6퍼센트도 채 완공하지 못했다. 지역 정치가 사업을 늦추고 있다.
items.title_en: Why is Berlin failing to build more bike lanes?

items.title_original: Why is Berlin failing to build more bike lanes?

items.raw_excerpt: A lot of people preparing for the inburgeringsexamen run into advice: “pick the longest answer”, “choose B if you are stuck”, “expect it to get harder as you go up a level”. Most of it is passed on in good faith. Almost none of it has ever been checked. Inburgeringscursus.nl coded 881 questions from 35 official exam sets – three years of the Staatsexamen NT2 plus the DUO practice exams. Here are the myths that came up most often: “Pick...
items.summary_en: Many people taking the Dutch inburgering exam follow popular tips like 'pick the longest answer' or 'choose B if you are stuck'. A Dutch website checked these tips with 881 questions from 35 official exam sets. Almost none of these tips had ever been tested.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 통합시험을 준비하는 많은 사람들이 '가장 긴 답을 고르라', '막히면 B를 선택하라' 같은 조언을 듣습니다. 한 웹사이트가 공식 시험 35세트에서 나온 문제 881개를 분석해 이 조언들을 검증했습니다. 대부분의 조언은 한 번도 확인된 적이 없었습니다.
items.title_en: Five integration exam myths tested against real exams

items.raw_excerpt: La tarjeta "gatuna" para el transporte público tiene un límite de dos compras por persona.
items.summary_en: A new cat-themed edition of Chile's Bip transit card has gone on sale. Each person can buy up to two cards. People are hurrying to get the limited edition card.

items.raw_excerpt: El joven abandonó Valencia y se instaló en Valdemoro-Sierra, Cuenca, donde encontró una oportunidad para abrir su propio negocio y construir un proyecto de vida lejos de los altos costes de las grandes ciudades.
items.summary_en: Mario, 23, left the big city of Valencia and moved to Valdemoro-Sierra, a small village in Cuenca. Fewer than 100 people live there. He opened his own bar and built a new life away from high city costs, and says success means never having to leave.
items.summary_ko: 23살 마리오는 큰 도시 발렌시아를 떠나 쿠엔카의 작은 마을 발데모로-시에라로 이사했다. 이 마을에는 주민이 100명도 되지 않는다. 그는 높은 도시 물가 대신 이곳에서 자신의 가게를 열고 새 삶을 일궜으며, 성공이란 떠나지 않아도 되는 것이라고 말한다.
items.title_en: Mario, 23, left Valencia to open a bar in a village with fewer than 100 people
items.title_ko: 23살 마리오, 백 명도 안 되는 시골 마을에 바를 열었다
items.title_original: Mario, 23 años, dejó Valencia para abrir un bar en un pueblo de menos de 100 habitantes: “El éxito es no tener que irme” - El Cronista

items.raw_excerpt: Espaço Portas do Sol, in Portimão, closed its doors on 1 September 2026, after twelve years of hosting and promoting activities in the fields of culture, art and wellbeing.
items.summary_en: Espaco Portas do Sol, a culture and wellness venue in Portimao, closed its doors on 1 September 2026. For twelve years it hosted activities in culture, art and wellbeing.
